newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline flat but June up $1.25 to May parity.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline flat but June up $1.25 to May parity.

text.p: European gasoline prices were little changed on Friday morning although there was some strength in forward June prices.
A Rotterdam premium unleaded barge traded at $197.75 a tonne but swaps for both the balance of May and June held either side of $197.
This compares to a premium of $1.25 for May above June on Thursday. Dealers said local demand remains muted and saw little interest from the United States.
"There's a chance we might see more material going to the States but nobody is moving at the moment," said a broker.
